description: District Secretariat Jaffna - The Pilgrimages (Jaffna District) Regulation 1981 Notification under Regulation 3
reasoning: This gazette notification fixes festival periods for pilgrimages under the Pilgrimages (Jaffna District) Regulation 1951 and its subsequent amendments. It deals with regulatory matters by specifying dates when the regulation shall be in force for various temples and churches, making it a legal/regulatory announcement rather than a government personnel, organizational, land, commercial, or other specialized category.
